claims.text: Hob was the son of Wiseman Gamwich. He made his living as a roper in Tighfield, a tradition which was passed along to his son Hobson and his grandson, Andy, who adopted the surname Roper.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Two Towers, "The Taming of Sméagol"

claims.text: Hob was married to Rowan, the daughter of Holman the Greenhanded. Their son Hobson was born in .
